clarification: The shared-window-bounds claim in the base review is conditional on an initially selected focused window. When zero focused application windows are initially reported, execute can obtain getRootInActiveWindow for non-meta operations. It then still requires one focused application window with the same root window ID and package before mutation, but skips the initial-versus-final bounds comparison if the initial selected-window metadata was null.
mouse_branch: mouseClick additionally requires the initially selected verified window metadata to be non-null, so this fallback cannot produce a mouse input.
semantic_set_text_branch: The fallback is available to set-text; the surrounding controller must retain its own actual focused WM/task and scope/geometry checks. The contract does not establish an atomic outer WM-token binding.
